statement: Header pin numbers are from Orange Pi Zero 3W User Manual v1.0 section 3.14 and the vendor gpio readall printed in section 3.15. Ball names are the names that table printed. This file still does not invent a pinctrl group for the vendor DTS. Directions are from the compute module toward the named device.

fields.name: Logical net name.
fields.bus: UART, I2C, GPIO, USB, HDMI, MIPI-DSI, MIPI-CSI, PCIE, FAN, RF, POWER, SD, STORAGE, BOOT, or none.
fields.direction: in, out, inout, power, passive, or nc, as seen from the compute module.
fields.notes: Constraints and open items. Not a pin number.

shared_module.role: Orange Pi Zero 3W. Both carriers inherit these. They are module connectors, not 40-pin assignments.

nets.name: USB_C_5V
nets.device: USB 2.0 Type-C power port on the module
nets.notes: Only legal boot source. 5 V / 3 A. No USB-PD voltage above 5 V. MagStack, Qi, and OTG VBUS are not OR-ed into this net.

nets.name: USB_C_OTG
nets.device: USB 3.1 Type-C OTG on the module
nets.notes: DisplayPort Alt Mode 1.4, 4K60 capable. ThoxClip gadget ACM + RNDIS uses this port toward a host phone when docked. DP Alt stays unused because ThoxOS 1.0.0 does not start a display server. Not the boot power input.

nets.name: HDMI_MINI
nets.notes: 4K60 capable, dual independent with DP Alt or MIPI-DSI. Display server is off in 1.0.0 (PowerVR compositor deadlock risk). Do not start X11 or Wayland to probe this port.

nets.name: MIPI_DSI
nets.notes: Optional panel on ThoxMini is not driven in 1.0.0. ThoxClip has no panel. Not a boot dependency.

nets.name: MIPI_CSI0
nets.notes: Unused by both SKUs in 1.0.0. The two CSI connectors are not individually numbered here; CSI0 is the first logical name only.

nets.name: MIPI_CSI1
nets.notes: Unused by both SKUs in 1.0.0. Second logical camera connector. Not a pin index.

nets.name: MODULE_FAN
nets.notes: This is the module 2-pin header, not a 40-pin PWM assignment. The name PWM_FAN is intentionally unused. Control method inside the module is not documented here. Populate before a sustained ThoxMini NPU run. Not a boot dependency. Not the ThoxClip power policy.

nets.name: PCIE_FPC
nets.device: PCIe Gen3 x1 FPC on the module
nets.notes: Connector exists. Unpopulated on both SKUs in 1.0.0. Do not route a device.

nets.name: IPEX_ANT
nets.notes: Module marking on the user-manual board photo reads Cdtech 20800D8-00. Kernel driver name is still the vendor modules aic8800_fdrv and aic8800_btlpm. Attach the pigtail before any radio test. ThoxMini routes the pigtail to the enclosure wall. ThoxClip uses this same radio as the clip link. This net is not the ESP32-C6 antenna.

nets.name: MODULE_UART_DEBUG
nets.notes: User manual section 2.11. Header pin 8 is TXD.0 and pin 10 is RXD.0. GND is pin 6. 3.3 V TTL, 115200, no flow control. Cross TX and RX to the USB-TTL. gpio readall shows both already in ALT2. Do not assign the ESP32 to these pins.

nets.name: MODULE_BOOT
nets.notes: Pins not numbered. Not used as a carrier strap. Do not flash boot0 from this contact.

nets.name: MODULE_PWR_TP
nets.notes: Pins not numbered. This contract does not claim they are the USB-C 5 V net and does not allow them as a second power inlet.

nets.name: MODULE_SD
nets.notes: Boot media, up to 128 GB. Vendor partition layout is kept. Do not rewrite the partition table.

nets.name: MODULE_EMMC
nets.notes: Optional 8/16/32/64/128 GB. Default unstuffed. Not a 1.0.0 boot device. A public parameter page has printed 8/16/32 only; confirm the footprint before any stuff.

nets.name: MODULE_UFS
nets.notes: Optional 32/64/128. Default unstuffed. Not a 1.0.0 boot device.

thoxmini.header: 40-pin assignments from the Zero 3W user manual. UART2 and I2C0 are enabled in orangepi-config. SPI3, UART6, and I2C2 stay off because they share pins.
intentionally_absent: GPIO_DOCK_DET is a ThoxClip net; Mini uses GPIO_MAG_PRESENT instead
PWM_FAN is not assigned; the fan is shared-module MODULE_FAN

nets.name: UART_ESP_TX
nets.notes: Header pin 11, PB0, UART2 TX. Enable overlay uart2. 3.3 V only. Do not use pin 8, which is the console. Baud is not the console 115200 unless the ESP firmware says so. ESP32 module SKU is still open.

nets.name: UART_ESP_RX
nets.notes: Header pin 13, PB1, UART2 RX. No RTS or CTS.

nets.name: GPIO_ESP_RST
nets.notes: Header pin 15, PE9, GPIO 137. Espressif EN is active-high. A carrier pull-down holds EN low until thoxos-carrier.service drives this pin high. Resistor value is not frozen.

nets.name: GPIO_ESP_BOOT
nets.notes: Header pin 22, PD0, GPIO 96. Held high for flash boot. Low at EN release selects download. Do not pull ESP32 GPIO8 low at the same time.

nets.name: I2C_MAG_SCL
nets.notes: Header pin 5, SCL.0. I2C0. Shared by 24C02 at 0x50 and INA219 at 0x40. Enable overlay i2c0. Carrier pull-ups to pin 1, 3.3 V.

nets.name: I2C_MAG_SDA
nets.notes: Header pin 3, SDA.0. 24C02 is 256 bytes. INA219 shunt value is not frozen. Neither device gates boot.

nets.name: GPIO_MAG_PRESENT
nets.notes: Header pin 29, PE12, GPIO 140. Active level is still read from the first marked prototype. Presence must not gate boot.

nets.name: QI_COIL_STUDY
nets.device: Qi coil, mechanical and power study
nets.notes: Not a boot source. Open circuit to USB_C_5V and to every PMIC output. Do not OR it into the module 5 V rail. Not a 40-pin assignment.

thoxclip.header: Dock sense on pin 31, PE13. Console stays on pins 8 and 10. No I2C device on this SKU.
intentionally_absent: hardware fuse or strap that offlines the Cortex-A76 cores
PWM_FAN; optional airflow uses shared-module MODULE_FAN only

nets.name: GPIO_DOCK_DET
nets.notes: Header pin 31, PE13, GPIO 141. Active level is still read from the first marked prototype. Undocked is a normal boot. Must not gate boot.
